text: A Cristal package has one or more CompositeParDef.
explanation: The phrase 'one or more' could imply either a single CompositeParDef or multiple CompositeParDefs.

text: The Condition class of a Cristal may have one or more PartCompositeMember.
explanation: The phrase 'one or more' could imply either a single PartCompositeMember or multiple PartCompositeMembers.

text: The CompositeParDef of a Cristal may be composed by one or more PartCompositeMember.
explanation: The phrase 'one or more' could imply either a single PartCompositeMember or multiple PartCompositeMembers.

text: The CompositeActDef of a Cristal may may be composed by one or more ActCompositeMembers
explanation: The phrase 'one or more' could imply either a single ActCompositeMember or multiple ActCompositeMembers.

text: The ActCompositeMember of a Cristal may have one or more ActivityDefinition.
explanation: The phrase 'one or more' could imply either a single ActivityDefinition or multiple ActivityDefinitions.

text: The PartDefinition node has any number of PartCompositeMember nodes.
explanation: The phrase 'any' could imply an unspecified number of PartCompositeMember nodes or a specific number.
